children: This week, insider trades were seen among bigwigs, including Microsoft
, Netflix
, and Boeing
. The following transactions occurred between November 9 and November 13.
Microsoft
Chief Marketing Officer Takeshi Numoto sold 5,000 shares at $531 each for ~$2.66M. The sale accounted for about 8.42% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 54,412 shares.
Netflix
co-CEO Gregory Peters sold 27,312 shares at $63.62 each for $1.74M. The transaction represented about 18.61% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 119,412 shares.
AbbVie

EVP and Chief Commercial Officer Jeffrey Stewart sold 40,619 shares at $293.60 each, resulting in a deal worth $11.93M. The sale accounted for about 32.46% of his holdings, leaving him with 84,509 shares.
Christopher Raymond, CEO of Boeing Global Services
, sold 2,994 shares at $174.91 each for around $523,666. The transaction represented about 5.83% of his holdings, leaving him with 48,338 shares.
CoreWeave
Chief Operating Officer Sachin Jain sold 13,611 shares at $46.23 each for $629,237. The transaction represented about 7.13% of his direct holdings, leaving him with 177,224 shares.
Blackstone
director Ruth Porat purchased 453 shares in the price range of $119.9 to $121.37 each for $54,721, increasing her holdings to 51,673 shares.
Super Micro Computer
director Scott Angel purchased 1,715 shares at $29.12 each for $49,941, bringing his total holdings to 8,770 shares.
DraftKings
director Gregory Wendt acquired 5,000 shares at $19.76 each for $98,800, increasing his holdings to 22,920 shares.
Prospect Capital
CEO John Barry purchased 5.24M shares at around $1.5 each for a total value of $7.78M, bringing his total holdings to 96.27M shares.
